title: Early Maya Writing at San Bartolo, Guatemala
lineage: Archaeological paper reports a ten-sign painted block in Las Pinturas, San Bartolo. Contextual charcoal and construction phases suggest painting between 300 and 200 BCE; its inscription is largely unread and the writing system did not originate with this surviving block.
